scope: Exact candidate readiness for human T3 SPEC review only

findings.title: Effective tool configuration is not bound to native effect replay identity
findings.counterexample: Same reviewed plugin/artifact and descriptor, valid config namespace A -> B, changed config/plan digests but same native fingerprint; shared tenant/operationKey/input replays confirmed A output in a G2 turn. This is a static permitted-path counterexample, not an executed exploit.
findings.invariant: Different effective tool bindings must not silently alias the native exact-composition/proposal conflict boundary.
findings.minimalNormativeCorrection: Bind each normalized tool/provider identity/version immutably to reviewed artifactDigest and canonical effective tool config across shared-journal scope; require a descriptor/provider-version change for changed bindings so the existing fingerprint changes, and reject aliases before publication. Specify any alternative proposal/operationKey semantics explicitly before BUILD.
